title: kissed with smoke norwegian savoy cabbage gratin
description: herbal, crisp, adventurous norwegian dish featuring savoy cabbage, smoke-hot, diabetic-friendly. pairs well with rye bread and a cold lager.
instructions: melt 2 tbsp of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped garlic and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
add the chopped savoy cabbage and cook for 5-7 minutes until slightly tender.
in a separate bowl, mix together the flour, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
add the low-fat milk to the bowl and mix until smooth.
add the grated cheddar cheese to the bowl and mix until well combined.
add the cooked savoy cabbage to the bowl and mix until coated with the cheese mixture.
transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the remaining 2 tbsp of butter.
dot the top of the dish with the remaining 2 tbsp of butter.
bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.
remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
